summary: Female body recovered from the Horsetooth Supply Canal on the evening of June 5, 2010, after she fell into the canal near the 6200-block of North County Road 29; body found near Larimer County Road 25E and County Road 38E; apparent accidental drowning, identity and final cause pending with the coroner.
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office (deputies, Emergency Services, Dive Team, Parks units); Loveland Fire and Rescue; Loveland Dive Team
notes: LCSO press release dated 2010-06-05 (John Schulz, PIO) reposted in RadioReference thread; 2010-06-05 was a Saturday, verified.
